title: Keep all definition surfaces independent of legacy execution
preconditions: Use independent copies of one identical case/evidence fixture; vary only run records across missing, passing, failing, blocked, skipped, stale and conflicting states.

steps.action: Compare Quality coverage, readiness, health and the definition reader across every run-state copy; inspect explicit history separately.
steps.expected_result: Coverage, readiness, health and definition reader are identical across run states; immutable legacy records remain accessible only as inert history.

expected_result: Keep all definition surfaces independent of legacy execution.
